study: Paired Talk2Car-mini inference and geometry tuning on six recordings

generation.fixed: Same checkpoint, images, pixel budget, greedy decoding, original batch order, and strict one-object parser. Apply the prompt option to both output tasks. Reuse the previous archived original-144 replies and verify an exact replay probe.
generation.single_target_suffix: Choose the one main physical object the command refers to, using any other mentioned objects only as context. The JSON array must contain exactly one element.

geometry.fixed: Same four scales, sampled points, camera bridge, fit and independent held-ray split, Qwen 2D vehicle rule, PCA/Qwen pose candidates, initial box recipe and top-correction evidence constraints.

comparisons.fixed_grid: All 16 generation/geometry combinations on all 113 descriptions. Report native, matched window-median, and matched frozen-no-roof controls for the same Qwen information. Retain every missing prediction and fallback.
comparisons.selection: Hold out each recording in turn. Rank within the other five using equal-recording Acc@50, followed by equal-recording mIoU, fewer deviations from the archived setup, then the registered profile and geometry order. The held-out recording contributes neither to ranking nor tie breaking.
comparisons.primary: Strict upright 3D IoU > 0.50. Report description-pooled and recording-macro summaries, Acc@25, mIoU, successful parses, 2D Acc@50, C_ray coverage, actual edits, rescue/harm and every recording. Provide both frozen method and window-median baselines. Resample whole recordings for descriptive paired intervals.
comparisons.deployment: Any exported full-cohort configuration is a Talk2Car development setting, distinct from recording-held-out predictions. Prefer evidence of benefit over the simpler same-information baseline. The general method registry is frozen.

target_labels_used_for: Post-seal scoring and five-recording configuration selection only.
